0022600039.text: The Utah Jazz, 1-10 overall and 0-5 on the road and on a nine-game losing streak, visit the 8-3 Houston Rockets in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Utah lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 140-106 defeat in Houston on 2026-04-03.
